text.description_html:
Schlage Custom Alexandria Glass Knob With Camelot Rose

The fancy Alexandria Glass Knob With Camelot Rose is a sparkling reminder of the old world. The Glass Alexandria Knobs enhances the elegant allure of this knob set. The Schlage Custom Alexandria Glass Knob With Camelot Rose will fit most pre-drilled doors.

Features of the Alexandria Door Knob:

  • One piece knob for better security and appearance.
  • Fits standard pre-drilled doors.
  • ANSI A156.2 Series 4000 Grade 2.
  • Pressure-cast zinc tubular lock housing.
  • Solid brass knob and trim rose.
  • Sold as complete set.
  • Easy to install.
  • Lifetime mechanical warranty on residential applications.

Specifications of the FC-Series Alexandria Schlage Door Knob:

  • Knob Material: Glass
  • Knob Diameter: 5.987"
  • Adjustable Backset for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Adjustable for 1-3/8" up to 1-3/4" thick doors

When Selecting a Function:

  • FC172: Double Dummy: For use as a pull or to match trim on both sides of the door. This set does not latch and does not lock.
  • FC21: Passage / Privacy: This knobset combines both passage (hall/closet) and privacy (bed/bath) into one lock. Simply insert the included privacy pin to make it privacy, or leave it out to keep it passage.

Special Ordered Item. NO RETURNS
